verdict.rationale: A documented public API for entity and registered-agent data is a fair question for a company-formation and registered-agent SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only dashboard-based management and a bare "Advanced API integrations" pricing line, which sits among bookkeeping and Stripe items and is not a documented API for entity records or registered-agent appointments. Probes for OpenAPI specs and llms.txt all returned 404, so there is no evidence of a documented public API for this story.
